newsitem.title: USA: Time Warner to license 12 films to cable - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Time Warner to license 12 films to cable - WSJ.

text.p: The movie companies of Time Warner Inc will license the rights to 12 movies to two of its cable services, The Wall Street Journal reported Thursday.
The Journal said the news came from Time Warner Wednesday.

The move continues a trend in which big media companies are increasing the value of their distribution businesses by putting their own programming on television networks or cable services they own, the story said.
Time Warner's Warner Bros, Turner Pictures and Castle Rock Entertainment will license the rights to Turner Network Television and WTBS for an undisclosed sum, the story said.
